title: Publish the full SeqRepo as a single archive to GCS and R2

commands.label: create-archive
argv: set -euo pipefail; tar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --no-acls --uid 0 --gid 0 --uname root --gname root -C /Volumes/RefgetStores/seqrepo -cf - full-2026-10-29 | pigz -6 > /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz; cp /Volumes/RefgetStores/seqrepo/full-2026-10-29.provenance.json /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/; cd /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV; shasum -a 256 full-2026-10-29.tar.gz | tee full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256; ls -l /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV

commands.label: verify-archive
argv: set -euo pipefail; echo top-level:; tar -tzf /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz | cut -d/ -f1 | sort -u; echo appledouble: $(tar -tzf /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz | grep -c '\._' || true); echo entries: $(tar -tzf /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz | grep -vc '/$'); tar -xzf /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz -C /Volumes/RefgetStores/extract.9qmU; diff -rq /Volumes/RefgetStores/seqrepo/full-2026-10-29 /Volumes/RefgetStores/extract.9qmU/full-2026-10-29 && echo diff: identical; cd /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV && shasum -a 256 -c full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256

commands.label: check-gcs
argv: set -euo pipefail; rclone check /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV clingengcs:clingen-public/seqrepo --one-way --include "full-2026-10-29*"; U=https://storage.googleapis.com/clingen-public/seqrepo; for f in full-2026-10-29.tar.gz full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256 full-2026-10-29.provenance.json; do printf "%s " $f; curl -sfI $U/$f | grep -i "^content-length" | tr -d "\r"; done; curl -sf $U/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256

commands.label: upload-r2-2
argv: set -euo pipefail; for f in full-2026-10-29.tar.gz full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256 full-2026-10-29.provenance.json; do rclone copyto /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV/$f theferrit32-public:theferrit32-public/seqrepo/$f --checksum --s3-no-check-bucket --stats 30s --stats-log-level NOTICE --stats-one-line; done

commands.label: check-r2
argv: set -euo pipefail; A=/Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.8PAV; bad=0; for f in full-2026-10-29.tar.gz full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256 full-2026-10-29.provenance.json; do l=$(md5 -q $A/$f); r=$(rclone md5sum theferrit32-public:theferrit32-public/seqrepo/$f --s3-no-check-bucket | cut -d" " -f1); ls=$(stat -f %z $A/$f); rs=$(rclone size --json theferrit32-public:theferrit32-public/seqrepo/$f --s3-no-check-bucket | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"bytes\"])"); echo "$f size local=$ls r2=$rs md5 local=$l r2=$r"; [ "$l" = "$r" ] && [ "$ls" = "$rs" ] || bad=1; done; U=https://static.ferriter.dev/seqrepo; for f in full-2026-10-29.tar.gz full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256 full-2026-10-29.provenance.json; do printf "%s " $f; curl -sfI $U/$f | grep -i "^content-length" | tr -d "\r"; done; curl -sf $U/full-2026-10-29.tar.gz.sha256; echo; [ $bad = 0 ] && echo "r2: all match"; exit $bad

validations.name: extract-and-diff
validations.detail: the archive extracts to a tree identical to the instance directory (diff -rq): one top-level directory full-2026-10-29/, 1,292 files, no AppleDouble entries

validations.name: gcs-rclone-check
validations.detail: 0 differences across the archive, its .sha256 and the provenance JSON

validations.name: r2-size-and-md5
validations.detail: each of the three objects has the local file's size and MD5

validations.name: public-urls
validations.detail: unauthenticated HTTPS serves all three objects at full content length from GCS and R2; each served .sha256 holds the archive's digest
